facts.fact_text: At 4.07 p.m. on 7 October 2009, the applicant notified the police that he planned to organise a demonstration on 10 October 2009.
The demonstration planned by the applicant was scheduled to run from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. on 10 October 2009.
The demonstration planned by the applicant was to take place in front of the Venyige Street prison in Budapest.
The purpose of the demonstration planned by the applicant was to protest against the "political persecution of national radicalism".
